d:
The song "Naach Meri Bulbul" from the 1974 Bollywood film Roti is a classic number that showcases the legendary voice of Kishore Kumar. The film, directed by Manmohan Desai, stars Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz. This particular track is a playful and satirical commentary on the exploitation of performers for monetary gain.​
